pick.headline: Yuri Andropov dies
pick.summary: On February 9, 1984, Soviet leader Yuri Andropov, who had headed the KGB for fifteen years before succeeding Brezhnev, died after fifteen months in office.
pick.significance: Andropov was the first KGB chairman to become party leader. His death, announced the next day, brought the elderly Konstantin Chernenko to power.
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of February 10, 1984, listed a section on the death of Andropov: the official announcement, TASS, Moscow radio and TV reports, TANJUG on the cause of death, and Soviet media behavior on February 10.
